title: Privacy policy
content:
Privacy Policy

ARTICLE 1: PREAMBLE

This privacy policy applies to the site: Hyaluronic Filler Market, operated by the company HMD DISTRIBUTION (HMD).

The purpose of this policy is to inform the users of the site:

  • Of the manner in which their personal data is collected and processed (any data likely to identify a user: surname, first name, postal address, e-mail, location, IP address, etc.);
  • Of the rights they have regarding this data;
  • Of the identity of the data controller;
  • Of the recipients of this data;
  • Of the site's policy regarding cookies.

This policy supplements the legal notices and the General Terms of Use that can be consulted on the site: https://www.hyaluronicfillermarket.com

ARTICLE 2: GENERAL PRINCIPLES REGARDING THE COLLECTION AND PROCESSING OF DATA

In accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), the collection and processing of users' data respects the following principles:

  • Lawfulness, fairness and transparency: the data is collected and processed with the user's consent or for clearly established legal purposes.
  • Limited purposes: the data is collected and processed for specific objectives.
  • Minimisation: only the necessary data is collected.
  • Limited retention: the data is kept for a restricted period, communicated to the user.
  • Integrity and confidentiality: appropriate security measures are put in place to protect the data.

In accordance with Article 6 of the GDPR, the collection and processing only take place if at least one of these conditions is met:

  • Consent of the user;
  • Necessity for the performance of a contract;
  • Legal obligation;
  • Safeguarding of vital interests;
  • Public interest task or public authority;
  • Legitimate interests pursued by the data controller or a third party.

ARTICLE 3: PERSONAL DATA COLLECTED AND PROCESSED

A. Data collected

The personal data likely to be collected on the Hyaluronic Filler Market site are:

  • Account information: Username, password, unique user identifier.
  • Billing and delivery address: Country, postal address, city, postal code.
  • Personal contact details: First name, surname, e-mail address, telephone, status (professional/private individual), company name, VAT number, transport method, payment with/without VAT, payment method, bank details (via secure providers).
  • Statistics and browsing behaviour: Visit sources, number of sessions, pages visited, time spent, basket, device ID, location, device type, cookies, IP addresses, browser data, pixels & web beacons.
  • Additional personal information: Purchase history, payment information, history of conversations with support.
  • Personal preferences: Wish list, marketing and cookie preferences.

This data is collected during:

  • The acceptance of statistical/marketing cookies;
  • The purchase of a product (to honour the order, proof of transaction);
  • The subscription to the newsletter (via a secure e-mailing tool, e.g. MailChimp);
  • Browsing on the site (improvement of the user experience);
  • The creation of a basket (information kept for a defined period).

The data is kept under reasonable security conditions for a maximum period of 5 years.

Purposes of processing:

  • Ensure the proper functioning of the e-commerce site (order, payment, delivery).
  • Improve the user experience and resolve any technical problems.
  • Provide information on products, services and promotions (with consent).
  • Prevent fraud, illicit uses, breaches of the Terms of Use.
  • Carry out statistical analyses (understand customer preferences).

B. Transmission of data to third parties

The data may be transmitted to the following third-party providers:

  • Payment services (Payline, Paypal)
  • Shipping and delivery services
  • Host (OVH, based in the EU)
  • Management tools (WordPress, WooCommerce, Google Analytics, Metorik, Facebook Business, Pinterest, Instagram Business)
  • E-mailing tools (MailChimp)

These third parties are required to respect the confidentiality and security of your data.

The data may also be shared if necessary to:

  • Comply with the law;
  • Prevent fraud, illicit uses, breaches of the Terms of Use;
  • Defend the legitimate interests of HMD DISTRIBUTION (HMD).

C. Hosting of data

The site is hosted by OVH, in France, within the European Union.

ARTICLE 4: DATA CONTROLLER AND DATA PROTECTION OFFICER

A. The data controller

HMD DISTRIBUTION (HMD)
Registered office: 4 Boulevard des Sablons, 92200 Neuilly-sur-Seine, France
SIREN: 801 260 175
E-mail: sales@hyaluronicfillermarket.com

B. Obligations of the data controller

The controller undertakes to:

  • Protect the data collected;
  • Not transmit it to third parties without informing the user;
  • Respect the initial purposes;
  • Secure the exchanges of data (SSL certificate);
  • Inform the user in the event of rectification, deletion or breach of confidentiality.

C. The Data Protection Officer (DPO)

Outsourced DPO, contact: sales@hyaluronicfillermarket.com

ARTICLE 5: RIGHTS OF THE USER

The user has the following rights:

  • Right of access, rectification, erasure;
  • Right to data portability;
  • Right to restriction of and objection to processing;
  • Right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing;
  • Right to determine the fate of their data after their death.

To exercise their rights, the user may contact: sales@hyaluronicfillermarket.com

The data controller responds within 30 days.

ARTICLE 6: USE OF COOKIES

The site may use cookies to:

  • Analyse browsing and traffic;
  • Improve the user experience;
  • Display personalised content.

The user's consent is requested for certain cookies (e.g. marketing). The refusal of certain cookies may limit the functioning of the site.

The user may object to the storage of cookies via the settings of their browser. Cookies are kept for a maximum of 13 months.

Third-party cookies (Google Analytics, Facebook, Instagram, etc.) may also be used, subject to their own privacy policies.

ARTICLE 7: MODIFICATION OF THE PRIVACY POLICY

This policy may be modified to comply with legal or technical developments. The user is invited to consult it regularly.

Last update: 08/12/2024

ARTICLE 8: ACCEPTANCE OF THE PRIVACY POLICY

By browsing the site, the user acknowledges having read, understood and accepted this privacy policy, in particular the processing of their data and the use of cookies.

SUBSCRIPTION TO THE NEWSLETTER

By subscribing to the newsletter, the user agrees to receive special offers, news and information. Their e-mail will be managed via a secure tool (e.g. MailChimp) and will not be communicated to third parties without consent.
